issue_context.title: `state_unsafe_mutation` with stores and derived snippet props
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

When using a store in a non-runes mode component (it took me a while to learn that using snippets does not equal runes mode), you get `state_unsafe_mutation` when passing `$derived` props from a snippet to an element in the DOM.
